title: A rule nested in another (CSS nesting) is named and measured whole, so look.set aims past its real specificity
steps: S1: From packages/tools/tracy-site-tools run: node --test --test-reporter=tap test/look-style.test.mjs test/look-set.test.mjs

S2: Read the tests named in run.tests (the dskeepjo home h1 as CDP read it: T4's `h1` rules and the landing's `h1` nested in `.tracy-native-landing.tracy-native-landing`, nestingSelectors and specificity (0,2,1)).
expect: color's `by` is '.tracy-native-landing.tracy-native-landing h1' with spec [0,2,1] — not 'h1'; `& .x` under .a reads '.a .x', `&.on` under .btn '.btn.on', `& > li` under '.menu .list' '.menu .list > li', `.x &` under '.a .b' '.x :is(.a .b)', `h1` under '.a, .b' ':is(.a, .b) h1', two levels nearest-first '.outer .inner h1'.
look.set on Joomla writes to templates/tracy/css/styles/base.css a rule starting 'body.item-247 h1' at least as specific as (0,2,1), holding 'color: #166534'.
evidence: dskeepjo 10/10/2026 (stand from 96a53b266), session jo-I4b: look.set answered LOOK_SET_NO_EFFECT 'color: #171717 by h1 in …/media/tracy-landing/native-landing.css' after writing body.item-247 h1 (0,1,2); CDP shows the winner nested in .tracy-native-landing.tracy-native-landing with specificity (0,2,1) — tasks/evidence/followups-2026-10-10/p2-look/jo-look-set-h1-*.json.
fence: a nested rule is desugared from CDP's nestingSelectors, and look.set beats the browser's own specificity

tests: 🔒 a nested rule is named whole
🔒 Joomla, a winner nested in another rule
